canonical_json.strings: Unescaped valid Unicode except JSON controls, quote and backslash; no HTML or U+2028/U+2029 escaping
canonical_json.numbers: Canonical base-10 integer tokens in -9007199254740991..9007199254740991, excluding negative zero, fractions and exponent notation; applies recursively to every wire value including payloads
canonical_json.typed_numbers: Finite safe-integer values only; typed negative zero is rejected rather than normalized
canonical_json.typed_fixture: specs/work-queue/fixtures/canonical-typed.json; construct literal descriptors as real typed values before serialization
canonical_json.numeric_rationale: Avoid cross-engine rounding before equality, request fingerprints and resource accounting; ensure a unique accepted integer representation
canonical_json.payload_preservation: Retain all accepted fields and decoded values recursively; no numeric/string coercion or Unicode normalization. Canonical formatting is not source-format preservation. Other exact quantities require explicitly supplied strings

codec_errors.comparison: Error codes are canonical; diagnostic wording and parser offsets may differ between engines

delivery_verification.exhaustion: evidence.attempts >= reconciliation.max_attempts OR commit.at - original Completion commit.at >= reconciliation.deadline_ms
delivery_verification.deadline_origin: The first effective Completion commit timestamp; restarting reconciliation never resets the deadline
delivery_verification.required_proof: Exact original native run/attempt terminal evidence is independently required; elapsed time never proves terminal state, nonlaunch, no effects or native release
delivery_verification.disposition: Must equal evidence.effects, which defaults to unknown; none additionally requires a positive receipt

embedded_effect_contract.location: Work payload.effect_contract; separate versioned intent namespace, not a QueueCommit or WorkDefinition field
embedded_effect_contract.verification: Closed {verifier_id:ReasonCode,expected:canonical JSON object}; both fields required when present
embedded_effect_contract.bounds: At most 128 unique output types, safe-integer 0 <= min <= max <= 128; no_writes:true requires no outputs
embedded_effect_contract.authority: Payload metadata is intent only. verifier_id must exactly reference the trusted compiled claim-adapters[output.type].verifier.id from the approved immutable worker configuration
embedded_effect_contract.compiled_aliases: Base v1 type/cardinality contracts also support trusted compiler-only safe-outputs.claim-adapters mappings from custom type to an independently verifiable built-in effect type. Prepared custom code never receives arbitrary write credentials; the central trusted broker produces real native receipts while retaining logical custom-type attribution
embedded_effect_contract.mapping_scope: Compiled target-repo is resolved and checked by immutable host/repository ID and approved scope. field-map accepts only built-in business fields, never Claim/run/routing/credential/proof fields; conflicts with fixed expected fields reject rather than silently override
embedded_effect_contract.expected: Must also satisfy the declared verifier's closed kind-specific schema; cannot choose transport, credentials, code, callbacks or widen approved effect scope
embedded_effect_contract.execution: Arbitrary custom code runs in isolated credential-free preparation; actual writes use the freshly authorized trusted per-Claim intent broker. AsyncLocal context alone is not a credential boundary
embedded_effect_contract.delivery: Independent receipt/resource proof under the original Claim and native attempt 1 is required; job success, effect-contract validity and no-write strings are not proof
embedded_effect_contract.queue_engines: Native queue codecs/replay retain opaque payloads losslessly; the compiler and lifecycle adapters own embedded interpretation and trusted verifier configuration

embedded_resource_scope.location: Work payload.resource_scope; optional separate version 1 namespace, no QueueCommit or Assignment fields
embedded_resource_scope.shape: Closed {version:1,resources:[selectors]}; at most 128 unique selectors; empty denies all writes
embedded_resource_scope.selector: Closed required repository plus optional kind, host, repository_id, resource_id, number, comment_id, run_id, ref, path; every supplied field matches exactly and conjunctively
embedded_resource_scope.default: Absent namespace inherits frozen and installed profile scope; explicit null, unknown fields, malformed IDs, duplicates and unsafe paths reject
embedded_resource_scope.intersection: Selector alternatives never widen frozen or installed profile.effect_scope. Existing Issue/PR targets also match the complete immutable Work.subject when present. Native run targets match the original worker run
embedded_resource_scope.trusted_target: The compiled per-Claim broker supplies complete actual SDK target fields, including authenticated parent identities for comments. Agent target metadata cannot replace stored Work scope
embedded_resource_scope.native: AuthorizeEffect requires one closed EffectResource target after current original Claim Completion and pending delivery; queue continuation remains independently authorized

schema_generation.checked_in_emitter: Dependency-free fail-closed TypeSpec-subset generator; not the official emitter
schema_generation.official_equivalence: Resolve local/external references and compare all 41 validation graphs, preserving bounds, closure, required fields, union alternatives and runtime extensions. Only redundant constant types, annotation metadata, ordering and plain-object unevaluatedProperties representations are canonicalized; unsupported shapes fail closed
schema_generation.official_validation: Separate genuine @typespec/compiler@1.16.0 and @typespec/json-schema@1.16.0 compile/emission with file-type=json and seal-object-schemas=true
schema_generation.schema_equivalence: Semantic equivalence of official emitted schemas and checked-in subset-generated schemas is not verified

projection.comparison: Exact equality of every serialized projection field; no field trimming or projection-equivalence normalization. Only separate performance measurements may differ
projection.repository: Normalized queue repository from the authenticated genesis Actor
projection.dispatch: Includes the frozen approved profile and lifecycle_writes counter, in addition to immutable original membership and independent native reservation state
projection.claim: Terminal Claims include terminal_commit_id from the causal Completion or cancellation commit
projection.observation_writes: Keys are canonical({condition,host,kind,repository_id,resource_id}); display repository/number coordinates never change gate identity or its budget

fingerprint: SHA256 hexadecimal of canonical({actor,kind,parameters}); excludes request ID, predecessor, timestamp, trace and tentative winners

independent_root_defaults.graph_id: SHA256 hexadecimal of UTF8 canonical(payload), not NodeID(payload text, root)
independent_root_defaults.enqueued: Trusted first ingestion timestamp; resubmission reuses stored immutable enqueued before exact definition comparison, never the newer source run timestamp
independent_root_defaults.distinct_nodes: Callers explicitly choose another graph_id or node_key; no source run ID or mutable clock is mixed into default identity

production_genesis.placeholder: DefaultPolicy zero40 revision is a pure constructor/fixture placeholder, never a production worker revision
production_genesis.default_route: Authenticated native repository default-branch head plus exact approved worker workflow file at that immutable revision; requires work_queue_assignment string input and active exact Actions registration
production_genesis.explicit_policy: Authenticated administrator Policy proposal initializes a genuine genesis using its original request ID/epoch and exact approved policy; no unrelated default route or synthetic installed policy
production_genesis.authority: Worker principal and credential/effect scopes come from the approved installed profile; producer/PR checkout SHA is never substituted for another worker route
production_genesis.installed_policy: Existing Policy is never automatically rewritten or reprovisioned during an ordinary publish or stable-request acknowledgment

dispatch_refresh.grant: Fresh native Observations may precede the maximal Claim prefix in one atomic commit, consuming the same operation budget
dispatch_refresh.automatic_read_budget: At most min(128, installed operations limit minus 1) distinct resources per fresh CAS prefix, with at most two typed native API reads per resource; retain one operation slot for an independent Claim
dispatch_refresh.budget_helper: Read-only ObservationRefreshBudget(state, requested) accepts integers in 0..255 and reserves one Claim operation with min(requested, installed operations minus 1); invalid helper arguments reject with ledger_invalid. This adapter argument is not a QueueCommit request field. Native automatic refresh requests 128. Grants pause or ledger_bytes at/above installed ledger_bytes watermark returns zero before any dependency read; exact append and recovery reservations remain independently authoritative
dispatch_refresh.missing_read_scope: Per-resource unknown without a foreign API call, never a global authorization denial for independent ready Work
dispatch_refresh.decision_clock: Capture the trusted dispatch decision time after refreshing native dependency evidence
dispatch_refresh.no_grant: Tentative Observations are discarded with zero Claims; no derived observe request, Git write, counter, identity or fairness mutation is permitted
dispatch_refresh.cas_loser: Losing tentative observations and grants are discarded; refresh native evidence and recompute from the winning prefix
dispatch_refresh.durable_observation: Only an independently explicit authenticated observe/reconcile request may durably record evidence without a Claim grant

release_retry_backoff.proof: Only the same-commit Release matching the cancelled Claim's dispatch_id may anchor retry backoff; validate its exact approved scope and native run/kind first
release_retry_backoff.origin: The matching Release evidence.checked_at, retained across delayed publication/CAS; another reservation's earlier proof never reduces this Claim's backoff
release_retry_backoff.without_matching_release: Use the cancellation commit timestamp, never an unrelated Release or proof
release_retry_backoff.exhausted_worker_closure: Only the original bound already-cancelled Claim's available/cancelled exhausted Work may receive attempts_exhausted through the same cancelled finish scope

identities.forbidden_characters: ASCII C0 controls and DEL; opaque payload/descriptor text is not an identity
identities.native_decimal_validation: The same 1..256 positive canonical decimal bound applies before wire schemas to authenticated principals, exact native run reads, typed Actor origins, installed worker profiles and producer keys; oversized native run IDs reject before API probes
identities.handle: h + one-based member index in original immutable group
identities.genesis_commit: q_ + SHA256(UTF8(genesis request.id)); no predecessor or newline
identities.commit_identity_validation: Opaque unique ID; publisher naming conventions do not authenticate a commit or invalidate other accepted version-3 IDs

validation_layers.structural: Generated closed schemas enforce positive decimal ID strings of at most 256 digits and at most 64 unique Claim observation references
validation_layers.identity_bytes: JSON Schema maxLength counts Unicode characters; both engines additionally enforce the declared x-utf8-max-bytes and identity control-character restrictions
validation_layers.actor_attempt: Actor.run_attempt structurally permits 1..4096 logical source attempts; worker authority semantically requires original attempt 1, as do native binding, Completion and Evidence
validation_layers.trusted_context: Schema acceptance is not authentication; normalized immutable principal IDs, role/repository/Claim scope, evidence, request fingerprint and policy/state-dependent limits are validated separately

defaults.per_account_limit: Absent; the default account can use all pool capacity
defaults.enqueue_order: First causal commit ordinal, then operation index; enqueued is diagnostic only

recovery_reservation.all_writes: Post-operation canonical ledger bytes plus remaining bounded closure/recovery reserve must fit ledger_bytes + recovery_bytes
recovery_reservation.new_admission: Canonical ledger bytes must not exceed ledger_bytes; remaining reserve must not exceed recovery_bytes
recovery_reservation.optional_observations: Must not exceed the ledger_bytes admission watermark
recovery_reservation.operational_controls: May use unallocated recovery capacity, never consume outstanding Work/Dispatch closure reservations
recovery_reservation.genuine_closure: Discharges only the reservations justified by its operation; the post-operation all_writes bound still applies

reserve_formula.claimed_current_outcome: Add 8192 only while Work is claimed; Completion or ClaimCancellation discharges this current-outcome escrow independently of future retries
reserve_formula.record_accounting: Canonical bytes include the LF and duplicated request operations/evidence; reserved envelopes cover bounded escaped actor/request identities

packing: Largest fair prefix; earliest compatible group includes byte fit; no skipped winner; preceding Observations count against operation budget
gate_identity: canonical({host,repository_id,resource_id,kind,condition}); display coordinates do not change identity

request_parameters.submit: {nodes:[complete Work operations]} exactly matches persisted operations
request_parameters.dispatch_next: {pool,max_claims,max_dispatches,max_bytes}; trusted observations and Claims regenerate after CAS loss
request_parameters.finish: {dispatch_id,claim_handle,outcome}; one Completion or ClaimCancellation, with an additional scoped WorkCancellation only for exhausted retry
request_parameters.other: {operations:[closed typed operations]} exactly matches persisted operations

provenance.actor: Normalized authenticated trusted ingestion context; submitted strings and Git authors do not authenticate
provenance.principal: Authenticated GitHub actor ID as a positive canonical decimal string; never mutable login. Policy worker principals and producer keys follow the same rule. Native launch actor.id is mandatory and triggering_actor.id, when present, matches the approved profile principal
provenance.native_correlation: Original native attempt 1 API proof matches approved workflow, immutable revision, repository, event and actor. Display title contains the complete delimited dispatch ID, never a substring of another group ID
provenance.evidence: Normalized authenticated API/activation/receipt verifier output; source strings do not authenticate
provenance.worker: Original immutable member plus durable exact run binding, attempt 1 only
provenance.worker_effects: Actual effects require the current Policy epoch, effective completed original Claim and a pending delivery barrier; verified Result or DeliveryFailure cannot authorize additional effects
provenance.logical_run_origin: Optional run_id/run_attempt are paired; producer/dispatcher logical source attempts may be 1..4096, while worker/native binding/Completion/Evidence remain original attempt 1
provenance.no_op_origin: Closed Actor/Request, fingerprint, repository, approved role and live scope validation precede fresh no-grant/idempotent previews; accepted stable request acknowledgment survives later scope closure
provenance.duplicate_node: Exact immutable existing definitions consume no new operations, bytes, request identity, or reserve; fresh requests still require current producer entitlement
provenance.worker_queue_controls: Fresh submit, dispatch_next and derived observations require the same current-epoch scoped verified Completion and a pending delivery barrier; verified Result and failed delivery deny new queue-control writes. Accepted identical requests recover before the fresh authority gate; read-only inventory remains available after Result/Release. Children inherit pool/priority/account, and dispatch_next cannot leave the parent pool
provenance.operator: Native publisher resolves credential principal from user API numeric id and repository permissions, never from flags or mutable login
provenance.foreign_dependencies: Explicit allowlist plus separately bound read client; the queue credential is not assumed sufficient
provenance.delivery: Native publication requires a trusted read-only DeliveryVerifier capability, never a receipt asserted by operator flags
provenance.writer_ruleset_automation: Explicitly deferred; trusted writer branch restriction remains a deployment precondition, not verified by this implementation
